name: housecallpro-mcp
description: Read estimates a Housecall Pro contractor sent you, and decline options you don't want.
long_description: Reads the customer-side Housecall Pro portal from the per-document link your contractor emailed or texted you: estimate line items, totals, tax, and the company behind it. Declining an option is supported, and asks you to confirm first — a confirmation prompt where the client supports one, otherwise a preview plus a one-time token. Approving is not automatable — Housecall Pro gates it behind a reCAPTCHA only the real page can produce.

tools.name: housecallpro_get_estimate
tools.description: Read an estimate your contractor sent you: line items, totals, tax, the company, and whether it still awaits your approval.

tools.name: housecallpro_get_invoice
tools.description: Read an invoice your contractor sent you: amount, subtotal, tax, what is still owed, and whether it can be paid online.

tools.name: housecallpro_get_company
tools.description: Look up the contractor behind an estimate: phone, email, website, address and default arrival window.

tools.name: housecallpro_list_links
tools.description: List the customer links this server is configured with (labels and document kinds only; never the tokens).

tools.name: housecallpro_decline_estimate
tools.description: Decline one or more options on an estimate. Destructive: asks you to confirm first, and cannot be undone from here.

tools.name: housecallpro_approve_estimate
tools.description: Always refuses: approval is gated behind a reCAPTCHA only the real page can produce. Explains how to approve in a browser.

tools.name: housecallpro_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that the server can reach Housecall Pro and that a configured link still resolves.

link.title: Customer link
link.description: The estimate or invoice link your contractor sent you (pro.housecallpro.com/mobile_estimate/… or client.housecallpro.com/estimates/…).

links.title: Customer links
links.description: A JSON array of customer links for several documents at once. Use HOUSECALLPRO_LINK instead for a single estimate/invoice link.

link_label.title: Link label
link_label.description: Label for the single link given by HOUSECALLPRO_LINK (defaults to "default").
